rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a hollow cylindrical tube or pipe.

example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 gun2 lau6 seoi2 wo3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the squeezable container holding toothpaste.

example.english: This toothpaste tube is almost empty.
example.traditional: 呢支牙膏管就快用完喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 zi1 ngaa4 gou1 gun2 zau6 faai3 jung6 jyun4 laa3

rows.note: Use this when “the Tube” refers specifically to London's Underground system.

example.english: When travelling in London, it’s hard to get around without taking the tube.
example.traditional: 去倫敦旅行，唔搭倫敦地鐵就周圍都唔方便。
example.jyutping: heoi3 leon4 deon1 leoi5 hang4 m4 daap3 leon4 deon1 dei6 tit3 zau6 zau1 wai4 dou1 m4 fong1 bin6
